scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix backend & npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.build:production: npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run prepare:ui --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run pack --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run dist:mac --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run dist:win --prefix desktop
